targetEvidence.note: controller exposes getCurrentMedia/getCurrentTime/getDuration/isPlaying but unversioned; v0.6.9 changelog claimed third-party API, not shipped in current package

effectiveTimeRule: wall time while player is playing and host window is observable; pause/ended/media-switch/hidden excluded; currentTime delta is never watch time (seek/loop/rate/episode-switch distort it); content-seconds would be a separately versioned metric; local-date midnight split; multi-instance independent

consumer.writePolicy: one idempotent event per qualifying local day; user tombstone never rewritten
consumer.fallback: SiplayerPlaybackTracker bounded controller sampling, opt-in default-off, experimental until upstream ships
consumer.canonicalSourceRule: upstream contract becomes canonical only after merge + release + real-host acceptance; fallback demotes to diagnostic compare; never double-count

privacy.identity: public ref/refKey/source/sourcePath or stable URL, bounded
